svg.text: Assembly drawing: section, exploded view, LED map
Third-party part sizes are placeholders: verify against the parts you buy
Gold: CNC aluminium, anodised (or printed + paint)
1 mm opal acrylic or frosted film
Printed black, holes over every LED (stl/04)
2 x INMP441, ports up to the window (blue dashes)
6 x M2, hold the LED PCB
Frosted sleeve (stl/02) over a 5 mm LED strip, 7.5 tall
Printed (stl/01): speaker opening, board bay, USB-C slot
Adafruit 3351: 3 W, 4 ohm, 70 x 30 x 17, faces down
XIAO ESP32-S3 + Adafruit 3006 amp, in front of / behind the speaker
3 x posts join body to plinth (ghosted, off the cut plane)
4 x 10 mm rubber feet, 3 mm tall
LED MAP: VIEW FROM ABOVE, FRONT AT THE BOTTOM
